claudeDecision.reason: Primary blockers are authority, authentication, persistence, semantic and performance defects. Sending an old package now risks integration delay and another visual fork.
claudeDecision.laterUse: After functional owners are frozen, optionally send one final frontend-only polish pass with exact current candidate, locked API/DOM contracts, and explicit no-backend/no-data/no-auth changes.
